qa_pairs.instruction: What is the default location of the platform configuration file for the FO Admin Nx driver on Linux and UNIX systems?
qa_pairs.output: For Linux and UNIX platforms, the FO Admin Nx driver uses the default configuration file located at **/usr/local/ASAM/data/asamplat.conf**.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which file path does the FO Admin Nx driver use as its default platform configuration file on Linux/UNIX?
qa_pairs.output: The default platform configuration file for the FO Admin Nx driver on Linux/UNIX is **/usr/local/ASAM/data/asamplat.conf**.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you specify a different platform configuration file for the FO Admin Nx driver?
qa_pairs.output: To use a different platform configuration file with the FO Admin Nx driver, include the appropriate command line parameter when starting the driver and provide the full path to the desired configuration file.

qa_pairs.instruction: If the FO Admin Nx driver cannot locate its platform configuration file on a Linux system, what default location should you verify?
qa_pairs.output: Check whether the file **/usr/local/ASAM/data/asamplat.conf** exists, as this is the default location the FO Admin Nx driver looks for on Linux and UNIX platforms.

qa_pairs.instruction: Why might an administrator use a command line parameter to specify a platform configuration file for the FO Admin Nx driver?
qa_pairs.output: An administrator may use a command line parameter to point the FO Admin Nx driver to a custom configuration file when the default **/usr/local/ASAM/data/asamplat.conf** location is unsuitable, such as in environments with different directory structures, multiple configurations, or when testing alternative settings.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the platform configuration file location options for the FO Admin Nx driver.
qa_pairs.output: The FO Admin Nx driver defaults to **/usr/local/ASAM/data/asamplat.conf** on Linux/UNIX systems. If a different location is needed, you can supply an alternate file path via a command line parameter when launching the driver.
